scope: Documentary transfer/recovery reference semantics only; no physical permission or W02 implementation

fill.false_rule: Any proved FALSE dominates UNKNOWN; missing/stale/wrong-scope evidence cannot authorize motion
invalidation: new load or transfer operation, failed/aborted/rejected operation
lost retention, unaccounted dose or ledger change, re-opened transfer
fill.retained_history: D_DELIVERY_CURRENT was required at FILL-CONFIRM. A confirmed D1→D0 return does not retroactively require current D1 or change the dose receipt. Any unaccounted change invalidates the receipt. Expected material transaction is committed once by LOAD only after return; any resulting revision change requires explicit successor linkage, never automatic carry-forward. The committed successor explicitly binds receipt ID, all original identity fields, origin_revisions and current revisions. Only MATERIAL/FEED +1 from the frozen LOAD commit is allowed; any additional change needs new evidence. The original receipt is never edited or relabelled as a current D1 observation.
fill.isolation: FILL_COMPLETE plus exact completed LOAD ref, current D0 and FEEDER_SAFE before G0→G1. G1 pose alone never ISOLATION_CONFIRMED; independent current isolation/retention/load feedback with same material scope required at PRESS START.

commit_successor.origin_revisions: Exact receipt revisions before parent commit
commit_successor.scope: Same explicit receipt and LOAD operation only

sequence: new addressed recovery request with own guards
STOP-CLOSE with own full sweep/receipt/retention/current resource conditions
current B_RESET_CONFIRMED feedback for exact closure subject
RESTORE_B_CLOSURE resolves only addressed closure fault
separate RECONCILE_HISTORY per dependency fault after all causal faults resolved
new unique NEXT rechecks every own guard; original rejected operation IDs remain permanently rejected
recovery.unrelated_fault_rule: Material/service/receiver faults remain latched. If they invalidate any own motion guard (ledger, resource, retention, sweep etc), recovery is BLOCKED/INDETERMINATE. A closure-only request is never a blanket bypass for unknown causes.
